# lrmodel

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/diggsm/bios625_hw4/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/diggsm/bios625_hw4/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/diggsm/bios625_hw4/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/diggsm/bios625_hw4)
<!-- badges: end -->

The lrmodel package was designed to re-implement the base R function `lm()` and generate results from a linear regression model. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of lrmodel from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("diggsm/bios625_hw4")
```

## Usage

Below are example of how to use the `lrmodel` function to fit a simple linear regression model and explore the model results.

```{r}
#| label: example
library(lrmodel)

# Fitting a simple linear regression model
model <- lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
model$coefficients

model$call

summary(model$residuals)

model$rank
```


```{r}
#| label: fitted.vals
#| echo: false
plot(mtcars$wt, model$fitted.values)
```
